name: EPIC 205953480
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.9 solar radii and 0.94 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,255 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.94 solar masses and 7.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,728 K at its surface.
